_README: Per-card review status, consumed by tools/card_coverage.py.
The index's default inference — 'this card appeared in a game a reviewer
read, therefore it is checked' — OVER-CREDITS in three ways, and this
file is how a reviewer corrects it:
1. A reviewer does not check every card in a game. Only the ones named
in the prompt, plus whatever they trip over.
2. A card can be present all game with its relevant ability never
firing (Mutavault played as a land and never animated; Grim Haruspex
out while nothing died). Nothing was verified.
3. A card FIXED in the same session was reviewed against logs that
PREDATE the fix. The corpus shows the broken behaviour, so the fix
itself is unverified until a fresh batch runs.
Statuses:
verified   - live evidence, in a corpus at or after `since_sha`, that
the card behaved per its printed text. Retired from the
pool. Include what was checked, because 'I saw the tag' is
not the same as 'I verified the semantics'.
unexercised- present in a reviewed game but the ability in question
never fired. STAYS in the pool.
awaiting   - a fix landed AFTER the corpus that was reviewed. STAYS in
the pool until a batch at or after `since_sha` is read.
Keys are lowercase card names, matching data/card_data_cache.json.

anger of the gods.note: [REPLACEMENT] exile-instead registered at resolution on two separate turns, correctly turn-clamped.

bant panorama.note: Played, and correctly refused its sac-search with no mana - but the search itself never ran.

battlefield forge.note: [MANA-DAMAGE] dealt 1 to its controller on each colored tap.

bloodline keeper.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): front-face token ability inline-parsed; attacked at printed power.

boros signet.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): entered tapped under Blind Obedience only (not Authority); {1}: {R}{W} live.

captivating vampire.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): subtype anthem registered (+1/+1 other Vampires); tap-five activation unexercised.

cast down.note: Correctly REFUSED a legendary target (Kambal) - 'doesn't have required type'. The nonlegendary exclusion is live.

charcoal diamond.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): enters tapped; targetless mana ability refuses a target; same-turn re-tap refused.

crypt of agadeem.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): second ability never activated (only {T}: Add {B}).

dark depths.note: In test_snow_jorn but never drawn. Its generic enters-with-counters parse is the only live consumer besides Astral Cornucopia.

desecrated tomb.note: C4 live and DECISIVE: 2 cards left Qwen's graveyard, fired x1, exactly ONE Bat (the 2018-07-13 ruling). The Bat flew and connected.

domri, anarch of bolas.note: Reviewer C: [+1] added exactly ONE mana on both activations (never both colors); static +1/+0 scoped to its own controller.

elesh norn, grand cenobite.note: Both halves, correct sign and scope, and she excludes herself.

elspeth's nightmare.note: All three chapters plus the CR 704.5s sacrifice.

embercleave.note: ETB attach template resolved and equipped a real creature.

faerie guidemother.note: Reviewer A: single target, exactly +2/+1, flying granted, effect expired on schedule.

full moon's rise.note: Reviewer C: cast but COUNTERED before resolution, so its Werewolf-only anthem never registered.

furnace of rath.note: Correctly symmetric; the caster's own Comet Storm was doubled against himself. The May-30 house-rule removal stayed fixed.

gatekeeper of malakir.note: Kicker intervening-if correct on both a hand cast and a reanimated entry; entered tapped under Authority of the Consuls.

glacial chasm.note: Reviewer C, all four clauses: ETB land sacrifice, cumulative upkeep paid 2/4/6/8/10 then DECLINED at 12 and sacrificed, attacks refused while it was out, damage prevented.

goblin bombardment.note: Resolved inline x4 with real sacrifice costs and never reached Tier 3 - the fix that prevented the fabricated destroy.

goblin rabblemaster.note: [COMBAT-BEGIN-TRIGGER] resolved the token half INLINE (no Tier-3 call); no phantom extra attacker and no team pump.

gravecrawler.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): can't block -- never declared as a blocker; attacked at printed power.

grim haruspex.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): fired exactly 4x on a 5-creature wipe that killed it too (another + last-known information).

heart's desire.note: [ADVENTURE-TEMPLATE] created a nameless 1/1 white Human token (previously named after the adventure).

hypnotic sprite.note: Creature half verified; Mesmeric Glare (the adventure half) was never cast.

icebreaker kraken.note: [ETB-TEMPLATE] resolved with the honest 'no tap - the card doesn't tap them' message; affinity and snow-spend both applied.

ill-tempered loner.note: Now reaches the unhandled queue, but its damage-back effect still has no deterministic branch.

inscription of abundance.note: The player-target life mode ignored the explicit player and always used the caster's greatest power. It now uses the selected player's battlefield.

instigator gang.note: Live attack showed the attacking-only anthem skipped; dynamic combat-state P/T filtering now gives the front +1/+0 and transformed back +3/+0 only to attackers.

insult // injury.note: Both halves; aftermath zone gate correct in BOTH directions (rejected from hand, cast from graveyard); two-target split resolved. Its invisibility to MASS damage is the mass-damage handler's defect, not this card's.

killing wave.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): X=0 resolved as pay-0 for every creature incl. a devotion-5 Erebos (dynamic creature check).

kozilek, the broken reality.note: Combat damage and graveyard return resolved correctly.

magus of the coffers.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): cast; died as a 3/3 under a -1/-1 layer debuff to lethal damage; mana ability unexercised.

mesmeric orb.note: In test_escape_kroxa, drawn but never resolved (rejected for mana).

mind's eye.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): decline-when-unaffordable and pay-{1}-draw both live on the opponent's draw.

mutavault.note: Played as a land; the {1} animation was never offered or activated. The manland behavioural signal is absent, not disproven.

narfi, betrayer king.note: Registered a MULTI-subtype qualifier anthem ('other snows and zombies you control +1/+1') - the shape that previously registered nothing.

ob nixilis reignited.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): +1 draw/lose 1 and -3 destroy (creature-only) both correct across two games; -8 unexercised.

phyrexian negator.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: died to the damage that triggered it, so the drain's owner lookup came back None and the sacrifice fell to Tier 3 (which removed two permanents via a substitute action). Owner now resolved from the graveyard/owner_index. Awaiting a live death-with-trigger.

reanimate.note: The sixth-cycle corpus found a player-pronoun retry accepted despite Reanimate's Oracle allowing only a creature card in a graveyard. Player targets are now face-Oracle-gated before payment.

reaper from the abyss.note: Morbid intervening-if correctly declined on five separate end steps (CR 603.4).

reckless waif.note: Full classic werewolf cycle: transformed, back face declined correctly on later upkeeps, attacked at back-face P/T.

sengir vampire.note: Dies-trigger premise gate correct five times. Its 4 damage failing to kill was Selfless Spirit's indestructible, not a defect - the reviewer's closest false positive.

sheoldred, the apocalypse.note: [DRAW-TRIGGER] drained the opponent 2 on their draw; cost reduction from Jet Medallion also applied.

shepherd of the flock.note: Adventure cost selection exemplary - creature half failed for mana, adventure cost used instead, exile tracked, creature half re-offered. Printed-target width is a separate MINOR.

silverflame squire.note: Reviewer A: creature side never cast, adventure never attempted.

sunforger.note: Cast and resolved as equipment; never ACTIVATED, so the unattach-cost fix is still untested.

sword of light and shadow.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: its GRANTED protection was invisible to blocking (positional game arg) and its cast was held by the reanimate-shape check. Both fixed. Static +2/+2 verified live; the connect trigger still unexercised.

syr konrad, the grim.note: C4 live: 1 creature card left, fires x1 UN-consolidated (per-object). No N>1 case appeared; the unit pin covers it.

talisman of impulse.note: Reviewer C: dealt exactly 1 damage on each colored tap. The {C} half was not separately attributable.

tendershoot dryad.note: Subtype anthem registered ('saprolings you control +2/+2'); [ASCEND] city's blessing awarded at ten permanents.

tormod, the desecrator.note: C4 live: Faithless Looting flashed out of Rick's graveyard, 1 departure, fires x1 (consolidated), one Zombie token.

underworld sentinel.note: Attack trigger exiled a creature card from the graveyard with the dies-trigger link. The apparent self-exile was a Feldon TOKEN attacking while the real card was the exiled object.

usher to safety.note: Loaded as an adventure half only, never cast.

vampire nighthawk.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): flying (block refusals) + lifelink live; deathtouch unexercised.

vile entomber.note: ETB tutor to the correct zone (graveyard, not hand); deathtouch body present.

xenagos, the reveler.note: Proposed and rejected for mana, never resolved.

drana, liberator of malakir.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): fired 6x with CR 510.4-correct timing -- a regular-step co-attacker's power tracked the FS-step counters.

boar umbra.note: Totem armor never saved a creature enchanted by an OPPONENT's Aura - both helpers scanned only the creature controller's battlefield. Now searches every battlefield; the Aura dies to its own owner's graveyard.

dissipate.note: Shared the plain _counter_action, so its 'exile it instead' clause was dropped and the countered spell went to the graveyard. Dedicated generator now sets countered_to=exile.

dissolve.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): counter + scry 1 live twice (incl. Sapphire Medallion cost reduction).

setessan champion.note: Compound constellation resolved as draw-only; the +1/+1 counter clause was dropped across 9 fires. The watcher now emits both.

animating faerie.note: Its adventure half could never escalate to Tier 3 - the gate read `if not adv_msgs` while Tier 2 had already filled that list with a 'complex effect, escalating' placeholder. Cast three times, effect never happened.

mask of memory.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): cast but never equipped in two games; the connect trigger exercised in a third (Conspiracy Theorist folded the discard line).

sword of fire and ice.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): +2/+2 and both trigger halves (2 damage + draw) live twice.

sword of feast and famine.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): +2/+2 and the connect trigger's discard half live; untap-all silent when no land was tapped (plausible, not proven); protection unexercised.

sword of sinew and steel.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: the empty-board 'up to one' no-op ([]) was queued as unhandled by the equipment dispatch (x6 Tier-3 calls). The non-empty path resolved correctly live (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet destroyed). Awaiting a live empty-board connect showing 'handled no-op'.

strangleroot geist.note: Activated self-sacrifice reached the graveyard but missed the shared undying/persist save. Both self-sac and chosen-sac activation costs now reuse the graveyard-only save helper.

history of benalia.note: Seventh-cycle live evidence showed chapter III pumping Knights only; chapters I/II remained intact.

hollowhenge overlord.note: Seventh-cycle live upkeep created exactly five Wolves from the pre-resolution Wolf/Werewolf snapshot, including the source.

gisela, the broken blade.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): flying/first strike/lifelink live; P/T with Sword of Light and Shadow exact.

bruna, the fading light.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): cast trigger correctly declined (no Angel/Human in graveyard); Gisela tBB never drawn so MELD stayed unreachable.

mantle of the ancients.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): ETB return + auto-attach; static reconstructed exactly at 10 and 35 power; correct no-target no-op in another game.

sage's reverie.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: ETB drew 1 while the static half counted 2 (generic pattern captured 'a'). Name template counts every attached Aura incl. itself. Awaiting a live 2+ draw.

gorgon recluse.note: The block trigger lost counterpart identity and Tier 3 destroyed an unrelated creature. It now preserves stable IDs and destroys the nonblack counterpart at true end of combat.

fae of wishes.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: Granted announced under the creature's name (display). Countered -> graveyard verified correct. Wish effect unexercised (countered).

eldrazi conscription.note: Attached parameterized attack keywords were invisible because only printed attacker text was parsed. Attached Aura static grants now contribute annihilator without duplicating printed keywords.

tooth and nail.note: Cube FFA game 1537840778339160126 took a structured tutor_card2 plan through the formerly crashing production executor, paid the base {5}{G}{G} cost, put Torrential Gearhulk from hand onto the battlefield, and fired its noncast ETB. The earlier live corpus had already verified entwine semantics.

spider umbra.note: Seventh-cycle live cross-controller evidence: Spider Umbra saved Puppeteer Clique and the Aura went to its owner's graveyard.

khalni heart expedition.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): landfall quest counter live; the three-counter search unexercised.

decimate.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): all four target classes destroyed via template.

aurelia's fury.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): X=1: 1 damage + tap; X=0 with no target is a legal no-op.

blizzard strix.note: Generic ETB exile consumed the compound sentence and omitted the next-end-step return. The named template now requires another snow permanent and schedules the exact return.

aluren.note: The initial repair supplied free mana and flash but missed response-prompt game context and priority affordability. All cast/response paths now share the Aluren predicate; MV<=3 zero-mana response, absent-Aluren, MV4, and additional-cost controls are pinned.

howlpack piper.note: Tovolar's direct night path transformed the card without the shared transforms-into dispatcher. Awaiting a live Wildsong Howler draw-trigger confirmation.

counterspell.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): counter + CR 903.9 command-zone redirect of a countered commander.

bonecrusher giant.note: Cube game 1537622789408817162 verified front-face ingestion and the three-mana creature cast/resolution/combat path, but two legal Stomp opponent-target attempts exposed declared-target validation reusing the creature face. Implementation fd60fa2 now validates against the active Adventure face; the production-path pin casts Stomp, deals 2, and moves Bonecrusher Giant to Adventure exile. Awaiting fresh live Stomp evidence before promotion.

primeval titan.note: Strict cube FFA game 1537847378839609484 verified the complete deterministic path: Primeval Titan fetched exactly two lands tapped on ETB, then each of three attacks fetched exactly two more tapped lands, shuffling once per trigger and firing land-entry/landfall handling.

lightning runner.note: Cube FFA game 1537840778339160126 exercised four attacks: energy advanced 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 8, then Lightning Runner paid eight, untapped four controlled creatures, and granted an additional combat. The phase was correctly discarded only because that combat eliminated the final opponent and ended the game.

obsidian fireheart.note: First FFA game 1537820738592186419 falsely treated the upkeep ability quoted inside Fireheart's activated ability as Fireheart's own trigger. Implementation bf812f5 strips activated-ability lines before the battlefield upkeep predicate while preserving real and reminder-text upkeep controls. Awaiting a fresh live negative confirmation.

goblin goliath.note: First FFA game 1537820738592186419 resolved its each-opponent ability with a stale eliminated seat named as the sole opponent; the count was correct only by coincidence. Implementation bf812f5 gives Tier 3 every living opponent and marks eliminated seats unavailable. Awaiting fresh live multiplayer evidence.

goblin chainwhirler.note: Pre-fix cube FFA game 1537840778339160126 dealt one damage to Bot-Karn but skipped every creature and planeswalker he controlled, leaving a live 1/1 Akroan Crusader untouched. Implementation 203206d replaces the player-only JSON action with a shared non-targeting living-opponent board sweep, including stable-ID duplicate creatures, planeswalker loyalty, replacements/prevention, damage triggers, and duel/FFA controls. Awaiting post-fix live evidence.

goblin shortcutter.note: Pre-fix strict cube FFA game 1537847378839609484 cast Goblin Shortcutter into several legal opposing creatures, but the ETB was classified as having no actionable verb and made no creature unable to block. Implementation b4918f6 adds a deterministic targeted until-end-of-turn blocking restriction, legal-target recheck, cleanup and save/undo state, plus duel and multi-seat controls. Awaiting post-fix live evidence.

bloodthirsty adversary.note: Pre-fix strict cube FFA game 1537891334034165935 paid no {2}{R}, selected a creature, and fabricated a token. Implementation 43d8370 now pays each additional cost, accepts only distinct instant/sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less, exiles the originals, and queues real spell copies. Awaiting fresh live evidence.

nevermaker.note: Pre-fix strict cube FFA game 1537891334034165935 fired Nevermaker's LTB trigger but resolved zero actions because its template used the ETB key. Implementation 43d8370 registers the LTB suffix handler and tucks exactly one legal nonland permanent. Awaiting fresh live evidence.

sphinx of uthuun.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): 3/2 pile split correct on 4 separate flickers (the awaiting entry's live evidence).

act of treason.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: three casts at the caster's OWN creature fell to Tier 3 (_gen_temp_control searched only the opponent's board) and were refused on haste's reminder text. Fix resolves the untap/haste riders with no control change; the judge guard strips reminder text. Awaiting a live self-target cast.

behold the multiverse.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: a normal hand cast reached Tier 3 and the optional-payment guard refused it on foretell's reminder text ({3}{U} paid, draw-2 lost). Foretell's reminder is now a cast-time strip. Awaiting a live resolution.

quietus spike.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: no template — Glissa Sunslayer connected with the defender at 4 life and the 'loses half, rounded up' trigger was refused at Tier 3. Template added. Awaiting a live connect.

boros reckoner.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: reflect resolved via Tier 3, which also fabricated a 3-life gain for the controller. Deterministic branch reflects to the damaging source's controller. Awaiting a live reflect with no life gain.

eldrazi monument.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: x4 Tier-3 upkeep drains. Suffix template sacrifices a creature, else the Monument itself. Awaiting a live upkeep.

herald of anguish.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: x2 Tier-3 end-step drains (the M3 false-sacrifice is long gone; the real discard reached Tier 3). Suffix template. Awaiting a live end step.

volcanic geyser.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): X=2 to the face, exact.

inspiring vantage.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): entered untapped as the 3rd land; {R} chosen.

stifle.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): countered a Rhystic Study trigger; a second, independent trigger resolved separately (correct).

vineglimmer snarl.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): entered tapped with no Forest/Island revealable.

shardless agent.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): cascade into Cyclonic Rift, cast free, bounce + CR 903.9a redirect.

liliana's caress.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: the opponent-discard watcher class had no scan at all -- Rick discarded under Qwen's Caress and lost nothing. _fire_opponent_discard_watchers added. Awaiting a live drain.

anticipate.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: resolved as nothing at Tier 3 (invented card names). Impulse-look pattern + library_to_bottom action. Awaiting a live resolution.

impulse.note: Same shape as Anticipate (the only other cache card); pattern-covered. Awaiting a live resolution.

demonic dread.note: Batch 8cc5a1a: 'target creature can't block this turn' had no pattern and no judge vocabulary. Generic pattern + both vocabulary blocks. Awaiting a live block refusal.

whip of erebos.note: Batch 8cc5a1a (Sep 1 wave): reanimate activation never affordable before it was destroyed; the lifelink static verified live.
